# GIF to Frames

GIF to Frames is a free browser-based tool for splitting animated GIFs into individual image frames.

The tool runs locally in the browser. Files are not uploaded to a server. No account, watermark, or installation is required.

## Core capabilities

- Extract animated GIF, WebP, or APNG frames as PNG, JPG, or WebP images.
- Preview every frame with adjustable playback speed.
- Select all frames, a range, the first frame, the last frame, or every Nth frame.
- Filter transparent or duplicate frames.
- Export selected frames as ZIP.
- Inspect and export frame delay, size, offset, disposal, and transparency as JSON or CSV.
- Reverse selected frames into a new GIF.
- Create a sprite sheet from selected frames.
- Combine PNG, JPG, or WebP images into a GIF.

## Privacy

All decoding, previewing, selection, and export work happens in the user's browser. Source files do not need to be uploaded.
